roadmap.title: Confirm the first fintech problem and success measure
roadmap.description: Choose one target user and problem. Record discovery evidence, an accountable product owner, a measurable outcome, excluded scope and a fixed experiment allowance. Acceptance: a signed-off experiment brief with a baseline or an explicit unknown; no real-money flow is activated.

roadmap.title: Qualify the opportunity radar
roadmap.description: Review official organizer rules, eligibility, geography, team size, dates and timezone, allowed prior work, IP terms, submission needs and cost. Separate open-confirmed opportunities from incomplete listings and a future watchlist. Acceptance: a dated scorecard and a go/no-go decision with source links.

roadmap.title: Validate the user journey and sandbox choice
roadmap.description: Map user pain, workflow, competing solutions, API support and test data. Select a synthetic-data problem in payments, open finance, reconciliation, lending support, risk or insurance operations. Acceptance: problem interview/research evidence, integration boundary and smallest useful vertical slice.

roadmap.title: Design the integration and risk boundary
roadmap.description: Create a data-flow diagram, idempotent event/ledger design, environment separation and recovery plan. Contract shared engineering, design and security. Acceptance: adapter contracts, threat review and tested failure-case design; no production customer records or payment privileges.

roadmap.title: Build and verify a runnable prototype
roadmap.description: Implement the scoped sandbox flow, deterministic fixtures, meaningful failure tests and replay/reconciliation checks. Acceptance: exact source revision, reproducible setup, measured behavior, known limitations and clear demo data labels.

roadmap.title: Prepare the event-specific submission
roadmap.description: Use the qualified rules to produce repository access, license/dependency attribution, runnable demo, accessible pitch, screenshots/video and a submission checklist. Acceptance: every rule maps to an artifact; submission remains prepared until an actual organizer receipt is recorded.

roadmap.title: Test the proposition and economics
roadmap.description: Create an audience-specific demo and landing-page draft, distinguish assumptions from measured demand, calculate experiment cost and cost per useful result. Acceptance: an evidence-backed next decision; no advertising allocation or external posting follows from the roadmap alone.

roadmap.title: Decide what graduates and archive the rest
roadmap.description: Review acceptance, source provenance, integration risk, event outcome and verified usage. Acceptance: continue/pivot/archive decision, owner, next milestone, reusable components and a compact handoff; awards and revenue require evidence.

knowledge.title: Fintech & Hackathon Studio operating charter
knowledge.summary: Purpose: research fintech opportunities, qualify hackathons, build sandbox prototypes and turn supported experiments into maintained products. The first office has nine departments. Four new domain specialists join existing director, knowledge, QA and blueprint definitions; engineering, design, research, security and hackathon services are reused. Employee records are persistent definitions, not continuously running model processes. Event listings need current rule and eligibility checks. All tasks name a deliverable, evidence, acceptance, owner and budget. Public operating guide: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/fintech-hackathon/README.md

knowledge.title: Fintech role prompts and handoff contracts
knowledge.summary: Director chooses one measurable outcome and dispatches the smallest dependency graph. Scout returns official sources, deadline/timezone, eligibility, rules and opportunity score; missing rules remain unknown. Analyst returns a problem brief, evidence, assumptions and a smallest test. Integrator returns sandbox contracts, reproducible prototype, ledger/replay failures and test receipts. Sprint producer returns scope freeze, ownership, demo assets and prepared/submitted receipt state. Shared QA checks actual outputs; knowledge curator archives artifacts and unresolved questions. Full prompts: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/fintech-hackathon/roles.md

knowledge.title: Official opportunity radar and fintech sandbox references
knowledge.summary: Opportunity sources are reviewed and dated, never a fabricated ranking. Research must distinguish an event announcement from verified open eligibility. Fintech scope includes payments/open finance, financial operations, risk/regtech, insurance and infrastructure; Web3 is one optional track. Current source register: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/fintech-hackathon/opportunity-sources.md

knowledge.title: Execution and budget state
knowledge.summary: This company kit creates definitions, contracts, planned milestones, a blueprint and knowledge references. It does not launch provider jobs, enroll in events, open financial accounts, move money or activate schedules. Jobs use existing global budget admission and explicit execution. A parent allocation is not extra spending permission. Shared specialists receive a scoped task packet rather than the entire portfolio.

knowledge.title: Opportunity scout task contract
knowledge.summary: Find at most five relevant fintech or hackathon opportunities from official organizers. Record exact edition, deadline and timezone, eligibility, prior-code/AI rules, submission artifacts and costs. Preserve unknowns; rank only after hard rule checks. Return dated evidence and next review, without enrolling anyone. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: Product discovery analyst task contract
knowledge.summary: Turn one sourced financial problem into a minimal user journey with known-answer synthetic fixtures, one success case and a material failure case. Separate facts, assumptions and measured outcomes. Return acceptance, alternatives, data definitions and excluded scope; do not infer demand from a demo. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: Fintech integration specialist task contract
knowledge.summary: Design or implement the selected sandbox integration from current official product docs. Pin environment, scope, typed events, idempotency, consent/credential expiry and reconciliation. Keep secrets out of artifacts. Return runnable fixtures or observed sandbox receipts, failure evidence and gaps; no real account or money operation. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: Hackathon sprint producer task contract
knowledge.summary: Coordinate the accepted sprint as a bounded dependency graph. Reuse shared contracts, name an owner and artifact at each join, reserve verification/packaging time and checkpoint before limits. Block successors on failed prerequisites and reconcile uncertain writes. Return actual completion, remaining costs and handoff. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: First proposed build — synthetic invoice/payment reconciliation
knowledge.summary: Proposed internal demo; not implemented or submitted to an event. Use synthetic integer-minor-unit records for invoices,payments,refunds and manual allocation. Cover duplicate events/transactions,conflicting IDs,missing/partial matches,refund ordering,excess refund,currency mismatch and revision-checked corrections. Acceptance: repeatable totals,transparent exception queue,recorded evidence and no real accounts. Brief and known-answer fixture: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/fintech-hackathon/first-demo-brief.md

board.title: Presence strategy, content and growth roadmap

roadmap.title: Create the client and account ownership register
roadmap.description: Choose personal, creator, professional, small-business or organization scope. Record authorized identity/account owners, audience, goals, channels, brand boundaries, client data separation and what can be published. Acceptance: account register and named accountable owner; account access remains unconnected until verified.

roadmap.title: Reconcile inherited projects and asset versions
roadmap.description: Index existing plans, source inputs, drafts, approved masters and published receipts separately. Keep financial scenarios separate from performance. Acceptance: one source-linked register with owner, version, supported status, next action and unresolved gaps.

roadmap.title: Create positioning, audience and channel briefs
roadmap.description: Define the offer, voice, message hierarchy, audience needs, editorial pillars, visual identity, accessibility and channel purpose. Acceptance: approved brand brief and per-channel role; personal reputation and organization positioning have distinct goals.

roadmap.title: Verify accounts and integration capabilities
roadmap.description: Check official OAuth scopes, account type, platform review requirements, supported actions, token storage, revocation and least-privilege roles. Acceptance: capability matrix with connected/manual/not-supported states; no passwords or tokens in chat, code or the asset ledger.

roadmap.title: Prepare the first content production cycle
roadmap.description: Create a rolling calendar with briefs, copy, artwork/video, captions/transcripts, alt text, rights and source checks. Route each item through named review and retain an immutable approved version. Acceptance: one complete small campaign pack with no implied publication.

roadmap.title: Establish publishing and community handoffs
roadmap.description: For supported authorized connections, bind the approved asset version, account, timezone, schedule and idempotency key. Otherwise export a manual handoff. Acceptance: status remains scheduled only after platform acceptance and published only after a platform ID/URL or verified manual receipt; community replies have explicit scope.

roadmap.title: Connect a trustworthy measurement baseline
roadmap.description: Define outcome, time window, source account, cohort, attribution limits, UTMs and deduplication. Keep reach, engagement, leads, accepted opportunities and recognized revenue separate. Acceptance: measured series have source timestamps; absent metrics stay unknown; forecast scenarios remain labeled.

roadmap.title: Run one bounded growth experiment
roadmap.description: Choose the smallest relevant SEO/content, conversion, lifecycle, ABM or paid experiment. Predefine success and failure checks, spend authorization, owner and stop/review conditions. Acceptance: attributable evidence and a continue/change/stop decision; a draft paid-media plan is not a funded live campaign.

roadmap.title: Exercise the account and reputation response playbook
roadmap.description: Prepare support routing, harassment/spam handling, public correction, compromise response, evidence retention and escalation. Acceptance: a tabletop scenario with named owners and recovery steps; private account data is limited to the authorized client context.

roadmap.title: Deliver the client report and next cycle
roadmap.description: Publish an internal handoff of accepted artifacts, receipts, measured outcomes, open decisions and the next proposed calendar. Acceptance: every claim traces to evidence; unresolved approvals, account access and metrics remain visible and no cross-client knowledge is shared by default.

knowledge.title: Social and digital presence operating charter
knowledge.summary: Purpose: manage the complete authorized brand presence for private individuals, creators, professionals, businesses and organizations. Eight initial departments cover client research/insights, technical integrations, brand/editorial, creative production, channels/community, growth/lifecycle, account trust and knowledge/delivery. Client Strategy and Insights are subteams within Research. Department labels are not separate client access controls; use separate client companies when confidentiality needs enforced separation. Guide: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/social-presence/README.md

knowledge.title: Presence role prompts and accountability
knowledge.summary: Director sets client scope, outcomes and task budgets. Brand strategist returns evidence-led positioning, voice and channel briefs. Editorial producer returns versioned campaign packs with source, rights and accessibility fields. Channel steward returns actual connection status, authorized publishing/community handoffs and receipts. Growth analyst returns measurement definitions, a bounded experiment and evidence-qualified results. Shared engineering, design, security, QA and knowledge support the work without cloning specialists. Full prompts: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/social-presence/roles.md

knowledge.title: Social platform capability and connection register
knowledge.summary: Consult current official platform documentation for account types, scopes, app review, publishing, analytics, moderation and rate limits. Every connection must say disconnected, read-only, publish-authorized, manual-handoff or unsupported with its verification time. Daftar has not connected any social account or sent a post/message through this company kit. Research matrix: https://github.com/occult-kranti/engineering-intelligence-atlas/blob/main/company/company-kits/social-presence/platform-capabilities.md

knowledge.title: Asset, campaign and outcome states
knowledge.summary: Source input -> draft -> review -> approved version -> scheduled with acceptance -> published with receipt -> measured with source/window/cohort. Rejected, cancelled, failed and unknown are separate states. A source register proves a record was referenced, not that the underlying artifact was re-opened or a campaign launched. Targets, scenario budgets, vendor case metrics and user-reported submissions retain their exact evidence labels. This operating policy is a role guide; native roadmap status remains planned/in-progress/blocked/done.

knowledge.title: Brand and presence strategist task contract
knowledge.summary: Define positioning, voice, audience needs and content pillars from the scoped source register. Preserve facts, hypotheses and unknowns separately. Return a source-linked proof bank, campaign brief and next test; do not invent approvals, results or biographies. Route claims requiring qualified review to Account Trust. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: Editorial and creative producer task contract
knowledge.summary: Turn an approved brief into a master and channel variants with copy, source references, accessible text, previews and version hashes. Preserve dates, offers, logos and qualifiers. Return a reviewable delivery packet; keep draft, approved and published states distinct. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: Channel and community steward task contract
knowledge.summary: Maintain account identity, calendar state, community handoffs and publication evidence. Validate the exact account, variant, audience, time and current authorization. Use only supported adapters; otherwise return a labeled manual package. Preserve uncertain attempts and reconcile before retry; a plan is not a publish receipt. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

knowledge.title: Growth and measurement analyst task contract
knowledge.summary: Check metric provenance, reporting windows, units and completeness. Separate paid/organic, attention, qualified demand and realized outcomes. Return reproducible findings with attribution limits and one measurable next experiment. Unknown is not zero; correlation alone is not lift. Input packet: company scope, source references, accepted prerequisite, deliverable, success checks and bounded budget. Return a concise artifact summary, evidence, limitations and next decision. Persistent identity does not imply an active background worker.

roadmap.title: Verify SDK source and supported module inventory
roadmap.description: Record the pinned upstream SDK, reviewed local patch, module compatibility and license. Acceptance: source SHA/package version and a reproducible validation command are in the evidence record.

roadmap.title: Define the first hardware product
roadmap.description: Use the Blueprint light example to define the desired behavior, board, ports, power assumptions and assembly instructions. Acceptance: a validated recipe and explicitly declared hardware inventory.

roadmap.title: Regenerate and compare the firmware source
roadmap.description: Run the existing generator twice against the accepted recipe. Acceptance: deterministic source digests and negative validation cases; generation is recorded separately from compilation.

roadmap.title: Verify the target compiler build
roadmap.description: Compile with a recorded toolchain and board target. Acceptance: real compiler log and binary hash; retain a blocked result if the target environment is absent.

roadmap.title: Measure the behavior on available hardware
roadmap.description: Only after confirmed equipment and scoped authorization, perform a bounded physical check with measured voltage/current and observable behavior. Acceptance: actual measurement receipt; absent hardware remains an explicit limitation.

roadmap.title: Review and archive the product handoff
roadmap.description: Independent review compares expected behavior with build and measurement evidence, records open limitations and links the accepted artifacts in Donna Brain.

knowledge.title: Atech SDK provenance
knowledge.summary: Use the reviewed project source and ledger. Local source generation exists; compilation and physical hardware validation require separate receipts.

knowledge.title: Hardware studio source plan
knowledge.summary: This kit makes the planned company structure installable. Its application receipt is separate from the earlier queued hosted command and from running workers.

knowledge.title: Blueprint light reference
knowledge.summary: Example recipe with button and neopixel; preserve declared inventory and deterministic generation evidence.

knowledge.title: Product design task contract
knowledge.summary: Own the brief, UI labels and assembly explanation. Return a bounded requirements record and a validated recipe; do not report physical performance from simulated behavior.

knowledge.title: SDK engineer task contract
knowledge.summary: Own validation, module placement, deterministic generation and compiler evidence. Distinguish tool installation, source generation, compilation and hardware execution.

knowledge.title: Independent verification task contract
knowledge.summary: Review negative cases, source/license provenance and measured hardware evidence independently of implementation. Record missing equipment and failed checks explicitly.

board.title: Scene brief, playable artifact and acceptance

roadmap.title: Pin the studio resources and engine sources
roadmap.description: Record the Three.js studio, reviewed model metadata, OpenCodeGameStudios module revision and engine/resource licenses. Acceptance: exact source refs and availability states.

roadmap.title: Define one playable scene and acceptance target
roadmap.description: Specify first-person/player controls, geometry scale, source fidelity and observable interactions. Use measured or sourced heritage geometry only where the evidence supports the precision claimed.

roadmap.title: Build the original playable scene
roadmap.description: Use the current scene workbench and relevant game/art modules. Acceptance: an executable artifact and controls demonstrated with real input. Keep source/model outputs distinguishable.

roadmap.title: Evaluate optional local model assistance
roadmap.description: Run bounded unseen prompts only when the actual model and device are available. Acceptance: model revision, measured latency, original outputs and failure cases; mock adapter tests do not count as inference.

roadmap.title: Verify geometry, input and performance
roadmap.description: Independently test keyboard/pointer input, reset behavior, frame timings and geometry provenance. Acceptance: raw observations and failed cases tied to the exact artifact.

roadmap.title: Archive the accepted scene and next improvement
roadmap.description: Link source refs, original assets, build and review receipts in Donna Brain; select one evidence-backed next round. Acceptance: retrievable artifacts and explicit unresolved limits.

knowledge.title: Procedural 3D studio
knowledge.summary: Original Daftar source and local deterministic helper; model weights/inference are separate unverified capabilities unless real receipts exist.

knowledge.title: Game development art pipeline
knowledge.summary: Use verified art fundamentals, procedural Three.js, Blender assets and engine import research by the assigned stage.

knowledge.title: OpenCodeGameStudios resource integration
knowledge.summary: Read only the relevant pinned module; resource definitions do not create employees or grant tools.

knowledge.title: Built heritage geometry and viewer
knowledge.summary: Preserve scale, source capture, provenance, unknown dimensions and independent checks. Interactive detail is not proof of survey accuracy.

knowledge.title: Design background library
knowledge.summary: Choose among reviewed background styles with motion/readability/performance acceptance; keep text contrast and reduced-motion behavior.

knowledge.title: World design task contract
knowledge.summary: Own composition, interaction, original scene code and source fidelity. Give the reviewer the executable artifact, controls and source scale/evidence.

knowledge.title: Local model engineering task contract
knowledge.summary: Own model provenance, dependency profile, adapter bounds and original output retention. Report actual device/memory/inference receipts separately from metadata and mocks.

knowledge.title: Scene review task contract
knowledge.summary: Own unseen evaluation prompts, input/reset checks, frame-time evidence and geometry-source review. Preserve failures and do not infer performance from screenshots.
